## What's Changed
### ⚠️ Compatibility Notes
* Require Python 3.11 or newer in every package; Python 3.10 installs resolve to 2.54.0 and earlier by @Kludex in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9526
* Record the tool requests of `ExaSearch`, `YouSearch`, `LocalStack` and other harness capabilities under durable execution by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9705
* Bound retained realtime audio like retained images with `retain_audio_max_seconds` by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9702
* Prefix `LogfireMCP` tool names with `logfire_` by @mpfaffenberger in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9868
* Serialize `FileUrl.media_type` as `null` for extensionless URLs instead of raising by [@pydanty](https://github.com/apps/pydanty) in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/8405
* Take realtime history, usage, and reply waits from the session core on OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, and xAI by @DouweM in https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai/pull/9612
* Keep default `run_id` and `conversation_id` stable when a durable run is re-executed by @Douwe
